title: Cutover ledger row
x-draft: ADR-0043 (proposed): the model, check and render landed first; the decider gates and revocation records follow; not frozen, may change before acceptance
description: One row of the cutover ledger (ADR-0043): one old-lab service, flow, agent, timer or dataset, its successor, its disposition and the proof for each transition. The machine state (old, new-shadow, new-primary, old-retired) is NOT a field: it is derived from the row's `transition` events (register_event). Additive to ADR-0043's field list: `plane` (a coarse group a gate can name, for example the pm200 power-off gate's `soc`), `decision` (who decided a drop, retire or archive, with a citation), `checks` (the gates passed so far: data verified, consumers repointed, soak), `soak_ends`, `hold` (why a row is held) and `links` (where the evidence is).

plane.description: A coarse group a gate can name (soc, power, edge, cti, ...).

old.description: Names from the old inventory's exports. A name is claimed by exactly one row.

new.description: The successor: a registry row, a module id, an agent key, a fleet unit or a dataset. null only while undecided, or when the disposition is drop, retire or archive.

gate.description: The evidence the row's kind requires for new-primary; `none-yet` means the capability has no conformance suite, which counts as a blocker.

decision.description: Who decided a drop, retire or archive (or a fresh start), and where it is written down.

checks.description: The gates passed so far. status is pass, fail, pending or na; a pass names its evidence under `links` or in `note`.

links.description: Evidence pointers: a plan section, an INVENTORY line, a commit, a log path. Names and paths only, never secret values.

audit.description: The design-vs-built audit rows (2026-11-22) this row closes.
